purpose: Provide a citizen-facing 'Why?' interaction for material answer statements, showing the supporting evidence, law, date/version, limitations and official source without exposing internal reasoning.
core_principle: WHY? → WHAT SUPPORTS IT → WHAT LAW APPLIES → WHAT DATE/VERSION → WHAT IS LIMITED → OFFICIAL SOURCE
rules: The Why view explains an already-approved claim; it does not create a new conclusion.
The supporting record is described only within its verified scope.
Property-specific claims retain property matching where material.
Historical claims retain target-date and legal-version context.
Conditions and exceptions material to the claim remain visible.
If evidence is incomplete, the Why view says what remains unestablished.
Official source links/routes are shown where available.
Restricted evidence is summarized only at the permitted access level.
No internal chain-of-thought, confidence score or hidden metadata is exposed.
hard_stops: Never invent support for a claim.
Never display a general source as property-specific proof.
Never turn the Why interaction into a new legal analysis.
